title: Number Quest Unit 6 · The Shape Shed (Launchpad)

items.q: A shape has 3 straight sides. It is upside down. What is it?
misconceptions: thought a turned shape has no name
items.why: It is closed and has 3 straight sides. Turning it does not change its name.

items.q: Which solid has a point on top and a round bottom?
misconceptions: picked the solid with square faces
picked the solid with two flat ends
items.why: A cone has one point and one flat round face. A cylinder has two round ends.

items.q: What makes a shape a square?
misconceptions: named the way it is turned
items.why: Color, size and turn can change. 4 equal sides and 4 square corners make a square.

items.q: You join two triangles side to side. What can they make?
items.why: Two triangles with a square corner fit side to side. They make a square.
A trapezoid is half a hexagon. Two of them side to side make all 6 sides.

items.q: Two squares side by side make which shape?
items.why: The two squares share one side. The new shape is long, with 4 sides: a rectangle.

items.q: A pie is cut in 2 equal shares. What is one share called?
items.why: Two equal shares are halves. One of them is one half.

items.q: Same cake. Which piece is bigger: a half or a fourth?
misconceptions: thought the bigger number is bigger
thought every share is the same
forgot the cakes are the same
items.why: Fourths cut the cake into more pieces. More shares make smaller pieces, so a half is bigger.

items.q: A rug is in 3 equal shares. How many thirds make the whole rug?
items.why: Three equal shares are thirds. Three thirds make one whole.
